-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HUC 8 MN WATERSHEDS
```{r}
huc8 <- request("https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/wbd/MapServer/4/query") |>
  req_url_query(
    where = "states LIKE '%MN%'",
    outFields = "huc8,name,states",
    outSR = 4326,
    maxAllowableOffset = 0.001,   # light server-side simplification (~100 m) for a faster download
    f = "geojson"
  ) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_string() |>
  st_read(quiet = TRUE)

mn <- states(cb = TRUE, year = 2023) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "MN") |>
  st_transform(26915)

huc8_mn <- huc8 |>
  st_transform(26915) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(st_geometry(mn)) |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>
  group_by(huc8, name) |>
  summarise(.groups = "drop") |>
  filter(as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) > 1e6) |>   # drop slivers under 1 km² along the border
  ms_simplify(keep = 0.05, keep_shapes = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326)

nrow(huc8_mn)   # should be roughly 80; Minnesota uses 80 major watersheds

st_write(huc8_mn, "data/huc8_mn.geojson",
         layer_options = "COORDINATE_PRECISION=5", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```

IMPAIRED WATERBODIES DATA ACQUISITION AND CLEANING

```{r}
url <- "https://enterprise.gisdata.mn.gov/aghost/rest/services/us_mn_state_pca/env_impaired_water_2026_draft/FeatureServer"
layers <- lapply(0:16, \(i) arc_select(arc_open(paste0(url, "/", i))))
rows <- c()
cols <- c()
for (layer in layers){
  df <- as.data.frame(layer)
  rows <- c(rows, dim(df)[1])
  cols <- c(cols, dim(df)[2])
}
dimensions <- data.frame(rows = rows, cols = cols)

```

```{r}
impairedlakes <- layers[[14]]
impairedstreams <- layers[[8]]
impairedwetlands <- layers[[12]]
impairedbeaches <- layers[[9]]
impairednativelakes <- layers[[13]]
impairednativestreams <- layers[[7]]
```

CLEANING FUNCTIONS

```{r}
impair_group <- function(code) {
  case_when(
    code %in% c("Hg-F", "Hg-W")                          ~ "Mercury",
    code %in% c("PFOS-F", "PFOS-W")                      ~ "PFAS",
    code %in% c("PCB-F", "PCB-W", "Dioxin", "DDT", "Dieldrin", "Toxaphene",
                "Ace", "Acetochlor", "Clpyr", "Chlorpyrif") ~ "Other toxic chemicals",
    code %in% c("E.coli", "FC")                          ~ "Bacteria",
    code %in% c("Nutrients", "DO", "Nitrates", "Nitrate", "Amm-U") ~ "Nutrients & low oxygen",
    code %in% c("TSS", "T")                              ~ "Sediment",
    code %in% c("Cl-", "SO4", "Al", "As", "Cu")          ~ "Salts & metals",
    code %in% c("FishesBio", "InvertBio", "ColdWater",
                "Temp", "pH", "PlantBio")                            ~ "Aquatic life & habitat",
    TRUE                                                 ~ "Other"
  )
}

clean_waterbodies <- function(data) {
  data %>%
  select(auid, imp_param, needs_pln) %>%
  mutate(any_needs_plan = str_squish(coalesce(needs_pln, "None")) != "None") %>%  # "None" = plan in place
  separate_longer_delim(imp_param, delim = ";") %>%
  mutate(imp_param = str_squish(imp_param)) %>%
  filter(imp_param != "") %>%
  mutate(
    imp_cat  = impair_group(imp_param),
    cat_rank = match(imp_cat, group_priority)
  ) %>%
  distinct(auid, imp_param, .keep_all = TRUE) |>   # drop any repeated code on the same water
  group_by(auid) |>
  arrange(cat_rank, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  summarise(
    primary_group     = first(imp_cat),
    all_groups        = paste(unique(imp_cat), collapse = "; "),
    impairments       = paste(imp_param, collapse = "; "),
    impairment_groups = paste(imp_cat, collapse = "; "),
    needs_pln         = first(needs_pln),
    any_needs_plan    = first(any_needs_plan),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
}

waterbodies_out <- function(data, summary, type){
  data %>%
  select(auid, name) %>%
  inner_join(summary, by = "auid") %>%
  mutate(water_type = type)
}

waterbodies_out_native <- function(data, summary, type){
  data %>%
  select(auid, name, indian_reservation) %>%
  inner_join(summary, by = "auid") %>%
  mutate(water_type = type)
}
```


```{r}
group_priority <- c("PFAS", "Other toxic chemicals", "Mercury", "Nutrients & low oxygen",
                    "Bacteria", "Salts & metals", "Sediment", "Aquatic life & habitat", "Other")

# LAKES

lake_summary <- clean_waterbodies(impairedlakes)
lakes_out <- waterbodies_out(impairedlakes, lake_summary, "Lake")

# STREAMS

stream_summary <- clean_waterbodies(impairedstreams)
streams_out <- waterbodies_out(impairedstreams, stream_summary, "Stream")

# WETLANDS

wetland_summary <- clean_waterbodies(impairedwetlands)
wetlands_out <- waterbodies_out(impairedwetlands, wetland_summary, "Wetland")

# BEACHES

beach_summary <- clean_waterbodies(impairedbeaches)
beaches_out <- waterbodies_out(impairedbeaches, beach_summary, "Beach")

# NATIVE LAKES

nativelake_summary <- clean_waterbodies(impairednativelakes)
nativelakes_out <- waterbodies_out_native(impairednativelakes, nativelake_summary, "Lake")%>%
  mutate

# NATIVE STREAMS

nativestream_summary <- clean_waterbodies(impairednativestreams)
nativestreams_out <- waterbodies_out_native(impairednativestreams, nativestream_summary, "Stream")
```

EXPORTING

```{r}
impaired_out <- list(lakes_out, streams_out, wetlands_out, beaches_out,
                     nativelakes_out, nativestreams_out) %>%
  lapply(st_transform, 26915) %>%                                         # meters, so the tolerance is in meters
  lapply(st_simplify, preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 25) %>%       # drop detail finer than ~25 m
  bind_rows() %>%
  st_transform(4326)

mn_counties <- counties(state = "MN", cb = TRUE) |>
  select(county_fips = GEOID, county = NAME) |>
  st_transform(26915)

huc8_areas <- huc8 |>                       # your HUC8 sf object
  select(huc8, huc8_name = name) |>
  st_transform(26915)

# One point inside each water, so a long river lands in exactly one county/watershed
water_points <- impaired_out |>                 # your combined sf, before st_write
  st_transform(26915) |>
  select(auid) |>
  st_point_on_surface()

areas <- water_points |>
  st_join(mn_counties, join = st_intersects) |>
  st_join(huc8_areas, join = st_intersects) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  distinct(auid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Waters that fell just outside the simplified county outlines get the nearest county
missing <- is.na(areas$county_fips)
nearest <- st_nearest_feature(water_points[match(areas$auid[missing], water_points$auid), ], mn_counties)
areas$county_fips[missing] <- mn_counties$county_fips[nearest]
areas$county[missing]      <- mn_counties$county[nearest]

impaired <- impaired_out |>
  left_join(areas, by = "auid")

st_write(impaired, "data/impaired_waters.geojson",
         layer_options = "COORDINATE_PRECISION=5", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```


Cleaning files for export

What we need
- Impaired Wetlands, layers[[12]]
- Impaired Lakes, layers[[14]]
- Impaired Streams, layers[[8]]
- Impaired Beaches, layers[[9]] NO APPLICABLE CASES
- Native impaired lakes, layers[[13]]
- Native impaired streams, layers[[7]] NO APPLICABLE CASES

ind <- c(7,8,12,13,14)
for (i in ind){

imp_lake%>%
  count(imp_param)%>%

PFAS DATA ACQUISITION AND CLEANING


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# MDH PFAS results for ALL tested community water systems
#   - purchased-water systems inherit results from the system they buy from
#   - long format: one row per system per compound
#   - per-system summary + color category for the map
# Outputs: data/pfas_all.geojson, data/pfas_long.json
# ==============================================================================

library(httr2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(jsonlite)

# EPA MCLs (ng/L). Hazard Index limit is 1 and comes from the `hi` column.
MCL <- c(PFOA = 4, PFOS = 4, PFHXS = 10, PFNA = 10, `HFPO-DA` = 10)

result_cols <- c("any_detections", "hi", "min_hi", "hi_text",
                 "mcl_detect_text", "mcl_status_text", "mcl_update_date")

# ---- 1. Fetch every tested system --------------------------------------------

pfas_url <- "https://services1.arcgis.com/RQG3sksSXcoDoIfj/arcgis/rest/services/PFAS_Unified_Feature_Layer/FeatureServer/0/query"

resp <- request(pfas_url) |>
  req_url_query(
    where = "pfas_tested = 'Tested'",
    outFields = paste(
      "pwsid", "name", "loc_city", "county", "pop_serv", "primary_source_type",
      "buys_from_pwsid", "any_detections",
      "hi", "min_hi", "hi_text", "mcl_detect_text", "mcl_status_text", "mcl_update_date",
      sep = ","
    ),
    outSR = 4326,
    f = "geojson"
  ) |>
  req_perform()

pfas_raw <- st_read(resp_body_string(resp), quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(mcl_update_date = as.Date(as.POSIXct(mcl_update_date / 1000, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")))

# ---- 2. Purchased-water systems inherit their seller's results ---------------

# Seller results, prefixed with s_ so they don't collide with the buyer's columns
sellers <- pfas_raw |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(pwsid, seller_name = name, all_of(result_cols)) |>
  rename_with(\(x) paste0("s_", x), all_of(result_cols))

# Fallback for rows with no seller ID: match the name from the "See X for results" text
name_to_id <- sellers |>
  distinct(seller_name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(seller_name, name_pwsid = pwsid)

pfas_all <- pfas_raw |>
  mutate(
    purchases_from_text = str_match(mcl_detect_text, "See<br/>(.*?)<br/>for results")[, 2] |>
      str_replace_all("<br/>", " ") |>
      str_squish(),
    purchased = !is.na(purchases_from_text) | coalesce(str_detect(buys_from_pwsid, "\\d"), FALSE)
  ) |>
  left_join(name_to_id, by = c("purchases_from_text" = "seller_name")) |>
  mutate(seller_pwsid = if_else(purchased,
                                coalesce(str_extract(buys_from_pwsid, "\\d{7}"), name_pwsid),
                                NA_character_)) |>
  left_join(sellers, by = c("seller_pwsid" = "pwsid"))

# Copy the seller's results into the buyer's columns (only for purchasers with a matched seller)
for (col in result_cols) {
  seller_val <- pfas_all[[paste0("s_", col)]]
  pfas_all[[col]] <- if_else(pfas_all$purchased & !is.na(seller_val), seller_val, pfas_all[[col]])
}

pfas_all <- pfas_all |>
  select(-starts_with("s_"), -name_pwsid, -purchases_from_text) |>
  rename(purchases_from = seller_name)

# Check: purchasers whose seller couldn't be matched (or whose seller is itself a purchaser)
pfas_all |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(purchased, is.na(mcl_detect_text) | str_detect(coalesce(mcl_detect_text, ""), "for results")) |>
  select(pwsid, name, buys_from_pwsid, purchases_from)

# ---- 3. Long format: one row per system per compound -------------------------

pfas_long <- pfas_all |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(pwsid, name, mcl_detect_text) |>
  separate_longer_delim(mcl_detect_text, delim = "<br/>") |>
  filter(str_starts(mcl_detect_text, "<b>")) |>              # drop footnotes and text-only lines
  mutate(
    analyte      = str_match(mcl_detect_text, "<b>(.*?)</b>")[, 2],
    min_ngl      = as.numeric(str_match(mcl_detect_text, "&nbsp;([0-9.]+)")[, 2]),
    max_ngl      = as.numeric(str_match(mcl_detect_text, "([0-9.]+) ng/L")[, 2]),
    min_below_rl = str_detect(mcl_detect_text, fixed("<sup>(1)</sup>")),
    exceeds_mcl  = str_detect(mcl_detect_text, fixed("(**)")),
    mcl_ngl      = unname(MCL[str_to_upper(analyte)]),
    mcl_ratio    = round(max_ngl / mcl_ngl, 2)              # NA for compounds without an MCL
  ) |>
  select(-mcl_detect_text)

# ---- 4. Per-system summary + color category ----------------------------------

system_summary <- pfas_long |>
  group_by(pwsid) |>
  summarise(
    n_compounds_detected = n_distinct(analyte),
    worst_ratio = if (all(is.na(mcl_ratio))) NA_real_ else max(mcl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    worst_compound = if (all(is.na(mcl_ratio))) NA_character_ else analyte[which.max(mcl_ratio)],
    compounds_over_mcl = paste(analyte[exceeds_mcl], collapse = " + "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pfas_all <- pfas_all |>
  left_join(system_summary, by = "pwsid") |>
  mutate(
    n_compounds_detected = coalesce(n_compounds_detected, 0L),
    # Overall ratio to the limit: worst single compound, or the Hazard Index (limit = 1)
    overall_ratio = pmax(worst_ratio, hi, na.rm = TRUE),
    above_mcl = mcl_status_text %in% "PFAS levels above MCL",
    pfas_category = case_when(
      n_compounds_detected == 0 & !above_mcl ~ "Not detected",
      above_mcl & overall_ratio >= 2         ~ "Above limit (2x or more)",
      above_mcl                              ~ "Above limit",
      overall_ratio >= 0.5                   ~ "Approaching limit",
      TRUE                                   ~ "Detected, below half the limit"
    ),
    pfas_category = factor(pfas_category, levels = c(
      "Not detected", "Detected, below half the limit", "Approaching limit",
      "Above limit", "Above limit (2x or more)"
    ))
  )

count(st_drop_geometry(pfas_all), pfas_category, purchased)

# ---- 5. Write ----------------------------------------------------------------

pfas_all |>
  select(-mcl_detect_text) |>                       # the parsed long table replaces this HTML
  mutate(pfas_category = as.character(pfas_category),
         mcl_update_date = as.character(mcl_update_date)) |>
  st_write("data/pfas_all.geojson",
           layer_options = "COORDINATE_PRECISION=5", delete_dsn = TRUE)

write_json(pfas_long, "data/pfas_long.json", dataframe = "rows", na = "null", digits = NA)
```

NITRATE DATA ACQUISITION AND CLEANING

Getting the data

```{r}
library(dataRetrieval)
nitrate_names <- c("Nitrate",
                   "Nitrate + Nitrite",
                   "Inorganic nitrogen (nitrate and nitrite) ***retired***use Nitrate + Nitrite")

pull_wqp <- function(lo, hi = NULL) {
  args <- list(statecode = "US:27",
               characteristicName = nitrate_names,
               startDateLo = lo,
               service = "ResultWQX3",
               dataProfile = "basicPhysChem")
  if (!is.null(hi)) args$startDateHi <- hi
  do.call(readWQPdata, args)
}

no3  <- pull_wqp("2025-10-01")
no32 <- pull_wqp("2022-10-01", "2025-09-30")
no33 <- pull_wqp("2020-01-01", "2022-09-30")   # starts Jan 1 so 2020 is complete

no3 <- no3%>%
  mutate(Result_Measure = as.numeric(Result_Measure))

no32 <- no32%>%
  mutate(Activity_DepthHeightMeasure = as.numeric(Activity_DepthHeightMeasure),
         Result_Measure = as.numeric(Result_Measure))

no33 <- no33%>%
  mutate(Activity_DepthHeightMeasure = as.numeric(Activity_DepthHeightMeasure),
         Result_Measure = as.numeric(Result_Measure))

nox <- bind_rows(no3, no32, no33) %>%
  distinct()                                     # drop any exact duplicate rows

# Checks
count(no3_all, Result_Characteristic)            # all three names should appear
no3_all %>% count(year = substr(Activity_StartDate, 1, 4)) %>% as.data.frame()

nox_slim <- nox %>%
  select(
    # Where
    Location_Identifier, Location_Name, Location_Type,
    Location_LatitudeStandardized, Location_LongitudeStandardized,
    Location_CountyName, Location_HUCEightDigitCode,
    # When / what kind of sample
    Activity_StartDate, Activity_TypeCode, Activity_Media,
    # What was measured
    Result_Characteristic, Result_Measure, Result_MeasureUnit,
    Result_MethodSpeciation, Result_SampleFraction,
    # Can we trust it / was it detected
    Result_ResultDetectionCondition, Result_MeasureStatusIdentifier,
    DetectionLimit_MeasureA, DetectionLimit_MeasureUnitA,
    # Who collected it
    Org_FormalName, ProviderName
  )
```

Cleaning the data

```{r}
NO3_TO_N <- 14.007 / 62.004   # ~0.226; nitrate "as NO3" -> "as N"

censored_conditions <- c(
  "Below Detection Limit", "Below Method Detection Limit", "Below Reporting Limit",
  "Not Detected", "Not Detected at Reporting Limit",
  "Present Below Quantification Limit", "Between Inst Detect and Quant Limit"
)

to_mgL <- function(unit) {
  u <- str_to_lower(str_squish(coalesce(unit, "")))
  case_when(
    str_starts(u, "mg/l") | u == "ppm" ~ 1,
    str_starts(u, "ug/l") | u == "ppb" ~ 0.001,
    TRUE                               ~ NA_real_   # mg/kg and anything unknown -> dropped
  )
}

# Minnesota drains to four basins: 04 Great Lakes, 07 Upper Mississippi,
# 09 Souris-Red-Rainy, 10 Missouri (far southwest)
VALID_HUC8 <- "^(04|07|09|10)\\d{6}$"

MAX_SNAP_KM <- 2   # border sites within this distance get the nearest county/watershed

# ---- 1. Clean values ---------------------------------------------------------

nox_clean <- nox_slim |>
  mutate(censored = Result_ResultDetectionCondition %in% censored_conditions) |>
  filter(
    !str_detect(coalesce(Activity_TypeCode, ""), "Quality Control"),          # drop QC samples
    !Result_ResultDetectionCondition %in% c("Detected Not Quantified", "Not Reported"),
    !is.na(Result_Measure) | censored,                                        # no value and no flag
    !Result_MethodSpeciation %in% "as NO2+NO3"                                # ambiguous basis
  ) |>
  mutate(
    species_mult = if_else(Result_MethodSpeciation %in% "as NO3", NO3_TO_N, 1),
    new_result = if_else(
      censored,
      as.numeric(DetectionLimit_MeasureA) * to_mgL(DetectionLimit_MeasureUnitA),  # non-detects: use the limit
      as.numeric(Result_Measure)          * to_mgL(Result_MeasureUnit)
    ) * species_mult
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(new_result),                     # unknown units
    !(censored & new_result >= 10)          # detection limits too high to say anything about the standard
  )

# ---- 2. Boundaries for filling county / HUC 8 --------------------------------
# Projected CRS (UTM 15N) so point-in-polygon and distances are planar

mn_counties <- counties(state = "MN", cb = TRUE, year = 2023) |>
  st_transform(26915) |>
  select(county_fill = NAME)

huc8_poly <- st_read("data/huc8_mn.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(26915) |>
  select(huc8_fill = huc8)

# ---- 3. One point per site ---------------------------------------------------

site_pts <- nox_clean |>
  distinct(Location_Identifier, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Location_Identifier, Location_LongitudeStandardized, Location_LatitudeStandardized) |>
  filter(!is.na(Location_LongitudeStandardized), !is.na(Location_LatitudeStandardized)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Location_LongitudeStandardized", "Location_LatitudeStandardized"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(26915)

# ---- 4. Spatial fill: inside a polygon, else nearest within MAX_SNAP_KM ------

nearest_within <- function(pts, polys, value_col, max_km) {
  idx  <- st_nearest_feature(pts, polys)
  dist <- as.numeric(st_distance(pts, polys[idx, ], by_element = TRUE)) / 1000
  if_else(dist <= max_km, polys[[value_col]][idx], NA_character_)
}

site_fill <- site_pts |>
  st_join(mn_counties, join = st_within) |>
  st_join(huc8_poly,   join = st_within) |>
  distinct(Location_Identifier, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Border stations that fell just outside the clipped Minnesota polygons
no_county <- is.na(site_fill$county_fill)
no_huc    <- is.na(site_fill$huc8_fill)

if (any(no_county)) {
  site_fill$county_fill[no_county] <-
    nearest_within(site_fill[no_county, ], mn_counties, "county_fill", MAX_SNAP_KM)
}
if (any(no_huc)) {
  site_fill$huc8_fill[no_huc] <-
    nearest_within(site_fill[no_huc, ], huc8_poly, "huc8_fill", MAX_SNAP_KM)
}

site_fill <- st_drop_geometry(site_fill)

# ---- 5. Merge: keep agency values when valid, otherwise use the spatial fill -

nox_clean <- nox_clean |>
  left_join(site_fill, by = "Location_Identifier") |>
  mutate(
    huc_raw = str_trim(as.character(Location_HUCEightDigitCode)),
    huc_raw = if_else(is.na(huc_raw) | str_detect(huc_raw, "^0*$"),   # NA, "", "0", "00000000" -> missing
                      NA_character_,
                      str_pad(huc_raw, 8, pad = "0")),
    huc_raw = if_else(str_detect(coalesce(huc_raw, ""), VALID_HUC8),  # codes outside MN's basins -> missing
                      huc_raw, NA_character_),
    Location_HUCEightDigitCode = coalesce(huc_raw, huc8_fill),
    Location_CountyName        = coalesce(na_if(str_trim(Location_CountyName), ""), county_fill)
  ) |>
  select(-huc_raw, -county_fill, -huc8_fill)

nox_clean <- nox_clean%>%
  filter(!is.na(Location_HUCEightDigitCode),
         !is.na(Location_CountyName))%>%
  mutate(Location_CountyName = str_remove(Location_CountyName, " County"),
         Location_CountyName = case_when(Location_CountyName == "Lac qui Parle" ~ "Lac Qui Parle",
                                         Location_CountyName == "Lake Of The Woods" ~ "Lake of the Woods",
                                         Location_CountyName == "Mcleod" ~ "McLeod",
                                         Location_CountyName == "St Louis" ~ "St. Louis",
                                         .default = Location_CountyName))
  
```

Exporting cleaned data

```{r}
sites_out <- nox_clean |>
  distinct(Location_Identifier, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    lon = as.numeric(Location_LongitudeStandardized),
    lat = as.numeric(Location_LatitudeStandardized)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) |>
  select(site_id = Location_Identifier, name = Location_Name, county = Location_CountyName,
         huc8 = Location_HUCEightDigitCode, org = Org_FormalName, lon, lat,
         type = Location_Type) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

sites_out <- sites_out |>
  mutate(water_type = case_when(
    str_detect(type, "^River|^Stream|Channelized|Riverine")         ~ "Rivers & streams",
    str_detect(type, "Lake")                                        ~ "Lakes",
    str_detect(type, "^Wetland")                                    ~ "Wetlands",
    str_detect(type, "Well|Spring|Gallery|Ground Water")            ~ "Groundwater",
    str_detect(type, "Storm")                                       ~ "Stormwater",
    type == "Land" & str_detect(name, regex("piezometer", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Groundwater",
    type == "Land" & str_detect(name, regex("tile", ignore_case = TRUE))       ~ "Farm drainage (tile)",
    TRUE                                                            ~ NA_character_   # precipitation, anything else
  )) |>
  filter(!is.na(water_type))

st_write(sites_out, "data/nitrate_sites.geojson",
         layer_options = "COORDINATE_PRECISION=5", delete_dsn = TRUE)

daily_out <- nox_clean |>
  filter(Location_Identifier %in% sites_out$site_id) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(Activity_StartDate)) |>
  group_by(site_id = Location_Identifier, date) |>
  summarise(
    nitrate_mgL = round(mean(new_result), 3),
    non_detect  = as.integer(all(censored)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(daily_out, "data/nitrate_daily.csv", row.names = FALSE)

daily_out%>%
  mutate(month_year = floor_date(date, "month"),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date))%>%
  group_by(year, month)%>%
  summarize(avg = mean(nitrate_mgL),
            median = median(nitrate_mgL))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = avg, group = month, color = month))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10)+
  theme_minimal()

daily_out%>%
  arrange(desc(nitrate_mgL))
```

NITRATE CHART 2

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Nitrate long-term trend: builds data/region_year.csv for the "Long-term trend" chart
#
#   1. Pick the trend sites (6+ years of data since 2020) and give each a region
#   2. Download their 2005–2019 results from WQP        (only needs to run once)
#   3. Clean the old results the same way as nitrate_daily, bind, save
#   4. One value per site per year, then the median across sites per region-year
#
# Last year included: 2025 (2026 results are still being uploaded to WQP).
# ==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(dataRetrieval)

first_year <- 2005
last_year  <- 2025    # drop the current, still-incomplete year
min_years  <- 6      # years with data since 2020 for a site to count as long-term

# Quality rules for the yearly medians. 1 = no rule (matches the version you exported);
# 3 months / 15 sites are the stricter rules from the method comparison.
min_months <- 1       # months sampled (Mar–Oct) for a site-year to count
min_sites  <- 1       # sites a region-year needs to be kept

dat   <- read_csv("data/nitrate_daily.csv")
sites <- st_read("data/nitrate_sites.geojson")


# ---- 1. Trend sites + regions -------------------------------------------------

huc_region <- function(huc8) {
  huc4 <- str_sub(huc8, 1, 4)
  case_when(
    huc4 %in% c("0702", "1017", "1023", "0710") ~ "Minnesota River & Southwest",
    huc4 %in% c("0704", "0708")                 ~ "Southeast",
    huc4 %in% c("0701", "0703")                 ~ "Upper Mississippi & St. Croix",
    huc4 == "0902"                              ~ "Red River",
    huc4 %in% c("0401", "0903")                 ~ "North (Superior & Rainy)",
    TRUE                                        ~ "Other"
  )
}

long_sites <- dat %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2020, year <= last_year) %>%
  distinct(site_id, year) %>%
  count(site_id, name = "n_years") %>%
  filter(n_years >= min_years)

site_regions <- sites %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(site_id %in% long_sites$site_id) %>%
  distinct(site_id, region = huc_region(huc8))

trend_sites <- site_regions$site_id

count(site_regions, region)


# ---- 2. Download 2005–2019 results (run once; the result is saved) ------------

nitrate_names <- c("Nitrate",
                   "Nitrate + Nitrite",
                   "Inorganic nitrogen (nitrate and nitrite) ***retired***use Nitrate + Nitrite")

# Small chunks so WQP doesn't time out or return incomplete data
chunks <- split(trend_sites, ceiling(seq_along(trend_sites) / 25))

pull_chunk <- function(ids) {
  readWQPdata(siteid             = ids,
              characteristicName = nitrate_names,
              startDateLo        = paste0(first_year, "-01-01"),
              startDateHi        = "2019-12-31") %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))   # chunks can disagree on column types
}

raw_old <- map(chunks, pull_chunk) %>%
  bind_rows()


# ---- 3. Clean the old results (same rules as nitrate_clean.R) and bind --------


NO3_TO_N <- 14.007 / 62.004

censored_conditions <- c(
  "Below Detection Limit", "Below Method Detection Limit", "Below Reporting Limit",
  "Not Detected", "Not Detected at Reporting Limit",
  "Present Below Quantification Limit", "Between Inst Detect and Quant Limit"
)

to_mgL <- function(unit) {
  u <- str_to_lower(str_squish(coalesce(unit, "")))
  case_when(
    str_starts(u, "mg/l") | u == "ppm" ~ 1,
    str_starts(u, "ug/l") | u == "ppb" ~ 0.001,
    TRUE                               ~ NA_real_
  )
}

old_daily <- raw_old %>%
  transmute(
    site_id    = MonitoringLocationIdentifier,
    date       = as.Date(ActivityStartDate),
    type_code  = ActivityTypeCode,
    value      = ResultMeasureValue,
    unit       = ResultMeasure.MeasureUnitCode,
    condition  = ResultDetectionConditionText,
    dl_value   = DetectionQuantitationLimitMeasure.MeasureValue,
    dl_unit    = DetectionQuantitationLimitMeasure.MeasureUnitCode
  ) %>%
  mutate(censored = condition %in% censored_conditions) %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(coalesce(type_code, ""), "Quality Control"),
    !condition %in% c("Detected Not Quantified", "Not Reported"),
    !is.na(value) | censored
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_used    = if_else(censored, dl_unit, unit),
    species_mult = if_else(str_detect(coalesce(unit_used, ""),
                                      regex("as ?no3", ignore_case = TRUE)), NO3_TO_N, 1),
    result = if_else(censored,
                     as.numeric(dl_value) * to_mgL(dl_unit),
                     as.numeric(value)    * to_mgL(unit)) * species_mult
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(result),
         !(censored & result >= 10)) %>%
  group_by(site_id, date) %>%                      # one value per site per day
  summarise(nitrate_mgL = mean(result),
            non_detect  = as.numeric(all(censored)),
            .groups = "drop")

new_daily <- dat %>% filter(site_id %in% trend_sites)

nitrate_trend_daily <- new_daily %>%
  bind_rows(old_daily %>%
              filter(site_id %in% trend_sites) %>%
              anti_join(new_daily, by = c("site_id", "date"))) %>%   # no doubled days
  filter(year(date) >= first_year, year(date) <= last_year) %>%
  arrange(site_id, date)


# ---- 4. Yearly values -> region_year.csv --------------------------------------
# Site-year value = median of monthly medians (March–October), so a burst of
# samples in one month can't dominate the year.

site_year <- nitrate_trend_daily %>%
  mutate(year = year(date), month = month(date)) %>%
  filter(month %in% 3:10) %>%
  group_by(site_id, year, month) %>%
  summarise(month_median = median(nitrate_mgL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site_id, year) %>%
  summarise(n_months = n(),
            median_B = median(month_median),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_months >= min_months) %>%
  left_join(site_regions, by = "site_id")

region_year <- site_year %>%
  group_by(region, year) %>%
  summarise(year_med = median(median_B),
            n_sites  = n(),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_sites >= min_sites,
         region != "Other")

write_csv(region_year, "data/region_year.csv")
```

HUC 8 MN WATERSHEDS
```{r}
huc8 <- request("https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/wbd/MapServer/4/query") |>
  req_url_query(
    where = "states LIKE '%MN%'",
    outFields = "huc8,name,states",
    outSR = 4326,
    maxAllowableOffset = 0.001,   # light server-side simplification (~100 m) for a faster download
    f = "geojson"
  ) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_string() |>
  st_read(quiet = TRUE)

mn <- states(cb = TRUE, year = 2023) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "MN") |>
  st_transform(26915)

huc8_mn <- huc8 |>
  st_transform(26915) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(st_geometry(mn)) |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>
  group_by(huc8, name) |>
  summarise(.groups = "drop") |>
  filter(as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) > 1e6) |>   # drop slivers under 1 km² along the border
  ms_simplify(keep = 0.05, keep_shapes = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326)

nrow(huc8_mn)   # should be roughly 80; Minnesota uses 80 major watersheds

st_write(huc8_mn, "data/huc8_mn.geojson",
         layer_options = "COORDINATE_PRECISION=5", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```
